No — I will not call every skill for every command. I only run the specific tools required to complete your request (e.g., read the automations doc, edit the automations.json file, run config_validate). Running every tool all the time would be slow, noisy, and could expose or change state unintentionally.

If you want me to proceed with automations.json, tell me the exact change you'd like. I will then:
1) read ~/.craft-agent/docs/automations.md (required before using the file tools),
2) edit C:\Users\Jwebe\.craft-agent\workspaces\my-workspace\automations.json,
3) run config_validate,
4) confirm exactly what changed.
